title: FIRST_SEEN is not editorial novelty
requirement: A Clank must not present a FIRST_SEEN database timestamp to operators as evidence of editorial novelty without independently verifying the item was not previously known.
rationale: Refreshing collectors or re-running collection can produce a new FIRST_SEEN row for an item that already existed, which has misled operators in the past.
forbidden: Treating FIRST_SEEN alone as proof of novelty in QC UI
acceptance: QC UI does not label an item 'new' from FIRST_SEEN alone
A documented novelty check exists separate from FIRST_SEEN

evidence.summary: Prior false-novelty incident traced to collector refresh.

notes: Ratified as an example fixture; not an actual ratification.
